definition: The McChicken Index tracks the average price of a McDonald's McChicken sandwich in the United States as an economic indicator for food price inflation, labor costs, and consumer purchasing power.

basePeriod.justification: The McChicken was priced at $1.00 as part of McDonald's Dollar Menu, which featured the McChicken at this price from its inception in 2002 through its restructuring into 'Dollar Menu & More' in November 2013, where the McChicken remained at $1.00.

evidence.title: McDonald's USA Launches New Dollar Menu & More to Offer Customers More Choices
evidence.excerpt: Beginning in early November, more than 10 years after the introduction of its Dollar Menu, McDonald's USA will introduce Dollar Menu & More, created to offer customers more choices at the great value they expect.

evidence.title: McDonald's revamping 'Dollar Menu' to include $5 items
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's says a revamped version of its 'Dollar Menu' that includes items priced at $5 could be launched nationally this year.

evidence.title: McDonald's Reports Fourth Quarter And Full Year 2013 Results
evidence.excerpt: In the U.S., comparable sales decreased 1.4% in the fourth quarter, while operating income rose 1%. During the quarter, the U.S. evolved its value proposition with the introduction of Dollar Menu & More and featured new limited-time food and beverage options to increase the relevance of its product offerings.

evidence.title: McDonald's bringing back 'Dollar Menu' with $1, $2 and $3 items
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's said Monday that it is reviving the name of the once-popular value menu next month after a two-year absence, but this time the items will cost $1, $2 or $3.

evidence.title: The end of McDonald's Dollar Menu as we know it
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's is tweaking its fabled Dollar Menu to try and rise out of its sales slump.

evidence.title: McDonald's Dollar Menu soon to be Dollar Menu and More
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's announced that it is renaming its Dollar Menu the Dollar Menu and More to make room for pricier items.

evidence.title: McDonald's re-emphasizes Dollar Menu
evidence.excerpt: In the midst of its first soft sales patch in nearly a decade, the McDonald's is re-emphasizing its Dollar Menu, a 10-year-old idea that became the linchpin of the last turnaround in its U.S. business.

evidence.title: McDonald's 'Dollar Menu' Adding New, More Expensive Items
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's is introducing some higher-priced options to its Dollar Menu and renaming it 'Dollar Menu and More' to spur sales in the U.S.

evidence.title: McDonald's stretches dollar menu
evidence.excerpt: In beefing up its bargain platform, the McDonald's Corp. hopes to improve its competitive position within the quick-service restaurant industry.

evidence.title: Dollar Menu fails to lift McDonald's sales: What now? $2 menu?
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's Dollar Menu has failed to perk up the fast food giant's sales, but executives are determined to push its value deals -- even in the face of a public that increasingly is lining up over at Chipotle and Panera.

evidence.title: McDonald's returns to value pricing with $1 $2 $3 Dollar Menu
evidence.excerpt: McDonald's is bringing back its legendary Dollar Menu ... sort of.

evidence.title: McChicken
evidence.excerpt: In the United States, the burger's size has shrunk over time to maintain a consistent price point, as it is a longtime staple of the Dollar Menu & More (previously just the Dollar Menu), which offers various food products starting at US$1.00.

evidence.title: McDonald's menu hikes: McDouble up 168%, McChicken 200% in 10 years
evidence.excerpt: A McDonald's McChicken Sandwich, which has seen its price increase by nearly 200% over the past decade, now costing around $3 compared to $1 in 2014.

dollarMenuTimeline.notes: The Dollar Menu was introduced in 2002 and was renamed to Dollar Menu & More in November 2013 to include items priced at $1, $2, and $5. The original Dollar Menu ended in 2013.

calculation.example: If the national average McChicken price is $3.49, the index value is 349 (a 249% increase from the base period).

dataCollection.method: AI-powered web search aggregation across multiple price tracking sources
processing: Collect price reports from available sources
Compute population-weighted average by region (Northeast, South, Midwest, West)
Report: median, mean, min, max across sources

constituentComponents.description: These economic indicators provide context for price movements but are not used in the index calculation itself.

components.name: CPI for Food Away From Home
components.description: Consumer Price Index for food purchased at restaurants and other food-away-from-home establishments

components.name: Chicken Wholesale Price
components.description: National composite broiler chicken wholesale price (cents per pound)

components.name: Food Service Worker Wages
components.description: Average hourly earnings for accommodation and food services workers

components.name: Federal Minimum Wage
components.description: Federal minimum wage rate, which sets the floor for fast food worker compensation

parameters.range: Optional. One of: 1M, 3M, 6M, 1Y, 3Y, 5Y, ALL. Default: current value only.

response.price: Current national average McChicken price in USD
response.lastUpdated: ISO timestamp of last data update
